name: CurrencyGuard
description: Get rate protection for any upcoming foreign payment or receipt — in seconds, from Claude. CurrencyGuard puts the kind of exchange rate protection usually reserved for large corporates into the hands of any SME buying or selling across borders. Give Claude the foreign-currency amount, when the payment is due, and whether you're paying or receiving; get back an indicative Guard quote that caps your worst-case rate while keeping the upside open, plus historic context on what could have moved against you. Covers GBP/USD, GBP/EUR and EUR/USD. No credit lines, no collateral, no API keys.

_published_faq.name: How do I add CurrencyGuard to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add CurrencyGuard to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.currencyguard.com/mcp.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the CurrencyGuard MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: CurrencyGuard provides these MCP tools: get_spot_rate, list_supported_currencies, get_forward_rate, resolve_settlement_date, price_guard, price_guard_extension, get_historic_best_worst, and explain_guard_product.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to CurrencyGuard?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to CurrencyGuard in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.
CurrencyGuard does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.
CurrencyGuard is developed by CurrencyGuard. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
